searchText: If they get DDoS’d then the local EL would just produce the block … or am I missing something? Yeap, the ddos vector is for the relay not the proposer. But falling back to the local EL, might delay block proposal time. And if it is delayed enough, there is a possibility of the block being orphaned A lot of miners on twitter said we should delay the merge over MEVBoost It is important to note, that MEVBoost is completely optional also given that in the current mainnet, relays are running with the same exact issues indicates this isn't an actual big deal. 😂😂😂 ignore it. Merge should go ahead as long as mev boost works and is safe because there’s mev enabled validator pools competing with public mev boost option and you don’t want chun wang’s lido to get 50%+. But I doubt it’ll take long to fix it or that it will delay merge more than anything else. https://goerli.beaconcha.in/ domain exists now Oh frumptuous day. Just in time for merge I can now forget that Prater ever existed, and just think about Goerli. Why does the merged net take on the name of the PoWChain but not the PoS CL? ^_^ Because users are everything, and they transact. perhaps we should be portmanteau'ing them. And consensus, stakers/miners, are service providers Goerter? Proerli? I won't call it mainnet. I will call it beacon chain. ✊ Streaming all client pairs for Goerli. Cycles every 10 seconds. https://www.twitch.tv/seamonkey1982 FWIW I saw one of your besu nodes was warning about not getting the `engine_exchangeTransitionConfigurationV1` message. Cycled too quick for me to catch whcih pair though 🙂
